Guidance & outlook: Based on the visibility we have today, we remain confident in our outlook for FY27.

Our guidance for FY27 is as follows: order backlog, we should end on March 31, 2027 at US$ 1.3 billion to US$ 1.4 billion (inadvertently stated - US$1.4 billion to US$1.5 billion: to be ignored), which is a growth of 65% to 75%.
So at least for next, let's say, next -- for FY27 and FY28, I'm expecting it to be in the range between 10% to 15% and after that, it should regularize to around 20% type of levels.
Growth & demand: The quarter also saw our order bookings of US$339 million, taking our order backlog to a record ever of approximately US$950 million, up 83% year-on-year and providing strong visibility for future growth.

Around INR12,000 crores of this growth is expected to come organically, supported by strong execution, conversion of our robust order backlog, sustained demand for AI-led digital infrastructure, deeper engagements with strategic customers and improved project execution.
The balance INR6,000 crores is expected to come through inorganic growth, leveraging our proven M&A engine, successful integration track record and a healthy acquisition pipeline.
Margins & costs: EBITDA margin expanded by 90 basis points to 9.3%, reflecting operating leverage, a better business mix, disciplined execution and the benefits of the structural initiatives implemented over the las t few years.
Our medium-term objective remains to consistently operate at or above a 10% EBITDA margin while maintaining healthy returns on capital.
EBITDA margins will range between 9.3% to 9.4%, which is again up by around 30 to 40 basis points.
Capex & expansion: Financially, we have delivered our highest ever quarterly revenue, supported by improved execution of the rising order backlog and the contribution from our recently acquired Brazilian entity, 2S.
The recently completed Brazil acquisition, which adds approximately US$50 million in annual revenue, represents another meaningful step towards this objective.

So INR60 crores came from the 2S Brazil acquisition because it was like two months and first quarter of them, which is basically the June quarter is normally weak for them because they are into a networking and the Cisco partners and all those things.
Balance sheet & cash: Cash flow continues to remain a key management priority.
For FY27, we expect our operating cash flow to EBITDA conversion to improve meaningfully over FY26, supported by disciplined working capital management.

We will continue to invest across three priorities: strengthening our people and technology capabilities, supporting the working capital requiremen ts of our growing business and pursuing selective acquisitions that enhance our capabilities and geographic reach.
Risks & challenges: Historically, quarter 1 has been a relatively softer quarter for Black Box.
